    (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 ∧ n = a * b} 10) ∧
    (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 ∧ n = a * b} 10) := by
  constructor
  · -- first set
    refine ⟨?mem1, ?least1⟩
    · -- existence of a,b with product 10
      refine ⟨1, 10, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Nat.succ_pos 0
      · exact Nat.succ_pos 9
      · norm_num
      · simp
    · -- minimality
      intro n hn
      rcases hn with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hdiv, rfl⟩
      have h2dvd : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 := by
        have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ (2000) := by norm_num

      have h5dvd : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 := by
        have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ (2000) := by norm_num
        exact dvd_trans this hdiv
      have h2ab : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        rcases (prime_two).dvd_mul.1 h2dvd with h2a | h2b
        · have h2a' : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a := (prime_two).dvd_pow.1 h2a
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h2a' b
        · have h2b' : (2 : ℕ) ∣ b := (prime_two).dvd_pow.1 h2b

        · have h5b' : (5 : ℕ) ∣ b := (prime_five).dvd_pow.1 h5b

      have h10ab : (10 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have hcop : Nat.Coprime (2 : ℕ) (5 : ℕ) := Nat.coprime_two_five
